frames.rejection: ambiguous SE3 registration: distinct comparable local fit

freeze.freeze_preparation: metadata only; raw depth and mocap are not read and registration is not invoked

ground_truth_interpolation.method: linear translation and shortest-arc quaternion SLERP

keyframe_policy.frame: initial accepted depth camera is the root; each reference is a recorded depth camera frame
keyframe_policy.initialization: first measured cloud self-registers at identity with all numerical guards
keyframe_policy.prior: last accepted sensor-only relative pose; identity after reference replacement
keyframe_policy.rejection: no pose output, no map update; excessive accepted-observation gap latches lost until explicit reset; evaluation never resets
keyframe_policy.replacement: copy accepted measured scan after minimum interval; no map union

uncertainty.calibration_data: already viewed original, fast120..131, tight140..151 and motion-v2 260..271; all are calibration/regression here
uncertainty.model: per-fit conditional covariance plus previously frozen diagonal engineering allowance only; no accumulated root-frame covariance or calibrated confidence

limits: Short temporal interval in one indoor Kinect room; no independent environment or automotive validation.
Accepted measured keyframes replace one reference cloud; no map union, loop closure, SLAM or global relocalization.
Root poses compose accepted local fits; per-fit covariance is not accumulated root confidence.
Missing references and rejected observations remain in the denominator; no truth resets or interpolated operational poses.
